rules.R123: pure function of pinned captures, pages and marks; as_of = production day; latest byte-equal (S101)
rules.R124: record rows per arena window; a trade = a round trip from startPosition 0 back to 0; P&L = sum closedPnl - sum fee; open trips counted, never valued
rules.R125: forks and controls from pinned marks over admitted non-void days, in bps of one unit, never USD
rules.R126: ROI not computed (SETTLED.md 4); rank within a unit class only, among rows with >= 1 trade; controls ranked with the forks
rules.R127: the dated pin, the latest pointer, the page section #ai-board, the routine's step 3f

what_is_not_claimed: No rank on the venue, no skill, no badge, no return: the record's entry in the venue's columns, graded by the chain and the pinned tape, for the venue to accept or not.
